mentions.story: Prefer associative ontologies to hierarchical taxonomies
mentions.text:
Hierarchies scale well, though, and are often found in complex systems, both natural and manmade, where this is an issue.

This classic paper (The Architecture of Complexity, by Herbert Simon, Nobel prize winner) explores hierarchy as an organizing principle in complex systems:

As a supplement to these I would also recommend checking out the lecture notes for 15-440, the intro distributed systems class. I took it spring of 2013 and thought it gave me a really good grounding in the material.
